title: cs-daily-scratchpad-jordan-lee-2026-04-02
content:
2026-04-02 - Morning scratchpad (Jordan)

Top of day priorities:
- ACME CORP QBR prep (Due 2026-04-04) — high priority
  - Pull usage + latency + error trends for last 90 days (need daily/hourly token counts).
  - Include 99th latency, avg inference cost per 1k tokens, and top 3 endpoints by volume.
  - Slide: recent incident summary (2026-03-28 outage) + mitigation + next steps.
  - Ask PM/Eng for timeline on persistent KV cache rollout (impact: cost reduction).
  - Add customer-facing summary: what we improved, how it helps (short bullets).
  - Owner: Jordan to draft slide; request metrics from Emily (consoles) by EOD 04/02.
  - Linked ticket: CONFLUENCE-ACCOUNTS-1287 (QBR deck skeleton).

- BETAHEALTH renewal (exp 2026-04-10) — medium/high
  - Renewal value estimate: $72k ARR (confirm pricing tier).
  - Confirm SSO + data retention docs required for procurement.
  - Reach out to legal for PO process timeline (Aisha).
  - Prepare one-pager: usage trends, cost savings from dedup caching suggestion.
  - Action: send renewal reminder email template to customer on 04/05 if no sign.

- GAMMALABS SSO integration follow-up — blocker
  - Waiting on OAuth config from their infra team. Ticket: JIRA-GL-559.
  - Eng task AG-3421 (replication bug) is causing token exchange failures on staging. Need ETA from eng.
  - If no fix by 04/03, escalate to SRE/eng rotation for temporary workaround.

Quick support follow-ups:
- ACME: response needed for model fallback behavior question (Slack thread). Action: send short doc + example SQL to illustrate fallback mapping. (Jordan)
- Nimbus AI: file upload errors intermittently on v2 endpoints — assign to Support L2 + include logs (request from customer). (Emily)
- RetailCo: asked about dedicated capacity pricing — attach Dedicated SKU sheet and link to compare with hosted. (Aisha)

Notes to self / meeting prep:
- QBR talking points (bullet list):
  1) 90-day health: usage, errors, latency trends.
  2) Cost optimization suggestions applied or planned (caching, quant profiles).
  3) Roadmap items relevant to Acme: private deploy timeline, SSO improvements.
  4) Open action items & owners + expected completion windows.
  5) SLA / support wrap-up + escalation path reminders.

- Remind: include a "what we need from you" clear ask slide (3 bullets max). Customers respond better to concrete asks.

- Attachments to prepare: QBR deck (slide), one-pager renewal, incident timeline (plain text), cost delta table (small table).

To-do (tick off as done):
- [ ] Draft QBR slide deck outline (Jordan) — start now, aim 2 hours.
- [ ] Request daily token breakdown from Console (Emily) — ping by 10:30am.
- [ ] Legal contact for BetaHealth PO process (Aisha) — cc Jordan.
- [ ] Ping eng for AG-3421 status + estimated fix date.
- [ ] Update renewal spreadsheet with BetaHealth numbers (local sheet).

Random quick ideas / brain dump:
- Consider adding a short optional appendix in QBR showing "cost per 1M tokens over time" with annotation of caching/quant changes. Helpful for execs.
- For customers with <200ms 95th latency, highlight as a performance badge on slide.

Communication snippets (copy/paste friendly):
- Renewal reminder (short): "Hi <Name>, quick heads-up that your Redwood Dedicated renewal is coming up on 2026-04-10. Happy to run through the plan + any questions — propose a 20-min touch base next week?"
- QBR scheduling ask: "Hi <Name>, would 2026-04-04 at 11am PT work for your QBR? Expect 30–40 minutes. I'll share a short deck in advance."

End-of-day notes to add after meetings:
- Capture any new asks and add to linked_artifacts (update this doc).
- Move completed items to final QBR prep checklist.

---
Meta: draft, will clean and push to Confluence once QBR deck skeleton is stable.
